mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saved_posts (user_id, post_type, post_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postType}, #{postId}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, post_type, post_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM saved_posts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_type = #{postType} AND post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_posts WHERE user_id = #{userId}
